Draft season 5 was a [[4on4]] [[TDM]] league that was running from October 2021 until December 2021. 95 players were drafted into 21 teams across three divisions.
===The Draft=== The [https://youtu.be/aTXFSWTdJQQ Division 1 draft] was held on September 26th, followed by [https://youtu.be/qo5TAp7Llcg Division 2 draft] on September 29th, 2021. The drafting process was streamed by {{player|Andeh|flag=se}} of [https://www.twitch.tv/suddendeathTV SuddendeathTV]. ==Prize Pool== '''3000 {{Abbr|USDT|Tether cryptocurrency (₮)}}''' is handed out to
